worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.summary: Blink around the target a few times with lightning-fast steps, then kick from the side it is not watching: a struck target loses Defence and is knocked away. More feints, and a distracted target, break its guard further. Patient style takes one more step and breaks two stages for a lighter kick; Rapid style kicks harder and faster.
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.descrip: A landed kick deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block kick radius.
Before the kick you blink %1$s times, %2$s blocks each, to stand %3$s blocks off the target's flank.

The kick leaves at %1$s blocks per tick; a hit lowers the target's Defence by %2$s stage (%3$s more from three or more feints, +1 more while it is busy attacking someone else) and it does not recover for the rest of the fight; the victim also bears a %4$s guard-break mark that lets Crush Claw tear deeper, and is knocked back up to %5$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.patient: Patient style: one more feint and two Defence stages per kick, at the cost of a lighter kick and longer preparation and cooldown.
Rapid style: one fewer feint and one Defence stage, but the kick lands heavier and faster.
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
From level %1$s the kick rises to %2$s.
From level %1$s the kick rises to %2$s and the guard-break mark lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.use.0: Blink to the flank and break the guard
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.use.1: Punish a target busy attacking someone else
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.use.2: Break one guard open, then knock it away
worldcombat.skill.thunderouskick.prefere: On: one more feint and two Defence stages per kick, for a lighter kick and longer preparation and cooldown. Off: one fewer feint and one stage, but a heavier, faster kick.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of blinking. Larger values open from further out.

On: prefer a target that is busy attacking someone else or already within 2.5 blocks (a distracted guard breaks one stage further), and rank already-guardbroken targets last. Off: treat it as an ordinary close attack.
world_combat.move.thunderouskick.text.bl: Kicked open %1$s stage from its blind side
